runs.label: opus55_judge_k3
runs.notes:
Final run: OpenCode + Claude Opus 5.5 on the judge set, k=3, build-final. Gates, S1 and printability pass in 9/9; 8/9 trials end with OpenCode's own EPIPE crash at shutdown, after submit (rewards valid).

**Where Opus lost points.** Only on S3, in 3 of 9 trials. The big loss is L3 uiW6Lhf (0.714): it cut one identical chamfer notch at all three different ribs (8.25 mm³ each, 1.55x V_ref) and submitted on its first passing test_fit, explaining "I didn't try to shrink the notches further because the clearance and seal margins are already small." The other two are small: L3 icocHFB (0.960) re-cut tighter but kept one radius (3.72 mm) for all three ribs (1.21x), and L2 hemm4Y8 (0.995) stopped at its first passing cut at 1.157x, just over the 1.15x full-points line. **Unlike Sonnet (0/9), Opus optimised after its first passing fix in 4/9 trials** (6tJLs9N, CUQv38r, UbNdaqs, icocHFB: undo all three cuts, re-cut smaller, re-check). The one L3 trial that sized each rib separately (UbNdaqs, arc radii 3.70 / 3.50 / 3.57 mm) landed at 0.93x V_ref. Demo quote (UbNdaqs, after replacing its first passing fix): "Total now ~14.8 mm³ (was 23.3). Running the free checks."

Three trials (L2 6tJLs9N 0.90x, L2 CUQv38r 0.91x, L3 UbNdaqs 0.93x) removed less than the best known fix: V_ref is not a strict lower bound (their arcs hug the rib's swept envelope, at 0.300-0.335 mm minimum clearance). S3 caps at full points, so this changes no reward.
